title: Pay $0.01/pixel to buy a canvas region. Provide x1,y1,x2,y2 for a specific posit
description: Pay $0.01/pixel to buy a canvas region. Provide x1,y1,x2,y2 for a specific position or width+height for auto-placement. Minimum region: 10×10 pixels. Returns region_id and owner_token. Use owner_token to update content later for free. Network: Base Mainnet. Each request purchases one region and returns placement coordinates plus the owner token.
